CREATE TABLE "public"."mcp_servers" (
  "auth_header" text,
  "cached_tools" json,
  "created_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "is_built_in" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "is_enabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "last_error" text,
  "last_status" text,
  "last_sync_at" timestamptz(3),
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "transport" text DEFAULT 'streamable_http' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "updated_by" text,
  "url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
